chunks: O my people, this she-camel of God is a token for you. So leave her alone to graze on God's earth, and do not molest her, otherwise the swiftest punishment would befall you.

key_terms.نَاقَةُ اللَّهِ: The she-camel of God (a specific miraculous sign)

ai.seo_question: What is the significance of the she-camel of God in Surah Hud?
ai.summary: In this verse, Prophet Salih (AS) presents the she-camel as a tangible 'ayah' (sign) of divine authority, inviting his people to witness its miraculous nature as proof of his prophethood. The command to 'let it eat from the earth of Allah' emphasizes that the creature belongs to God, and sparing it is an act of obedience, while harming it constitutes a direct challenge to divine power that invites imminent retribution.
